items.title: Has BSX Stock Finally Hit Bottom?
items.summary: Boston Scientific (BSX) stock has fallen about 57% over the past year, to about $45. The shares now sell for 3.2 times trailing sales, hovering near their decade-long historical trough of roughly 3.0 times and well off their 8.6 high.

items.title: Johnson & Johnson Partner Contineum Slides as Depression Drug Fails
items.summary: Contineum Therapeutics, Inc. (NASDAQ:CTNM) shares are trading lower on Tuesday as Phase 2 results from a key study disappoint. The pullback lines up with a risk-off tone in futures, but the company-specific clinical update appears to be the main driver. CTNM Stock Drops After Phase 2 MOONLIGHT-1 Results The company said its Phase 2 MOONLIGHT-1 trial did not meet its primary efficacy endpoint for JNJ-5120 / PIPE-307 in major depressive disorder.
